description: A structured oral-language intervention for four- to five-year-old children with relatively poor spoken language, developed at the University of York and marketed with I CAN.
title: Nuffield Early Language Intervention (NELI)

description: A BioQUEST-affiliated project that supports quantitative biology education through faculty-development workshops and shared instructional materials for undergraduate biology and mathematics educators.
title: NUMB3R5 COUNT (Numerical Undergraduate Mathematical Biology Education) project

description: A mathematical game-based learning environment developed by Phuong Bui et al.
title: Number Navigation Game (NNG)

description: Number Rockets is a scripted Tier 2 small-group mathematics tutoring program for first-grade students struggling in math, delivered by tutors in supplemental 40-minute sessions.
title: Number Rockets

description: A speeded assessment developed by Moore et al.
title: Number Sets Test

description: A 32-item oral and written assessment developed by Cowan et al.
title: Number system knowledge test (32 items)

description: Numbers in Nappies is an early-childhood flashcard intervention that uses repeated visual and auditory presentation of numbers, shapes, and colours for infants and toddlers.
title: Numbers in Nappies

description: A game-based Tier 2 mathematics intervention developed by Fien et al.
title: NumberShire Level 1 (NS1)

description: NUMi is a 20-item multiple-choice objective health-numeracy assessment covering number sense, probability, statistics, and tables and graphs, developed for measuring health numeracy in populations including medical students.
title: Numeracy Understanding in Medicine instrument (NUMi)

description: The Nurse Competence Scale (NCS) is a validated 73-item visual-analogue self-assessment instrument developed for measuring nurses’ perceived competence across seven professional domains.
title: Nurse Competence Scale (NCS)

description: A PowerPoint-based visual-and-auditory assessment developed by Harper (2011) to measure three-year-old children's knowledge of common nursery rhymes.
title: Nursery Rhyme Completion Statements assessment tool

description: A set of nursing-specific AI-education frameworks developed by Hoelscher and Pugh, Kobeissi et al., and Bester and Zeigler to organize nurses’ AI collaboration, AI-literacy objectives, and prompt-engineering skills.
title: N.U.R.S.E.S., AI-ABCs, and CARE frameworks

description: A paired online self-report assessment battery measuring nurses' clinical communication competency and caring ability, developed and administered by the study researchers.
title: Nurses' Clinic Communication Competency Scale (NCCCS) and Chinese Caring Ability Inventory (CAI)

description: The Nursing Simulation Teaching Information System (NSTIS) is an academic hospital-information-system simulator developed by the research team for nursing simulation teaching and assessment.
title: Nursing Simulation Teaching Information System (NSTIS)

description: Revised bedside-observation mini-CEX and DOPS forms for assessing novice nurses’ clinical skills and providing formative feedback through scaled criteria, self-evaluation, and evaluator comments.
title: Nursing-specific mini-CEX and DOPS assessment forms

description: A matched pair of self-report scales measuring nursing students' perceived clinical competence and patients' perceptions of care received from those students.
title: Nursing Students' Competence Scale (NSCS) and Patients' Perceptions of Nursing Students' Care Scale (PPNSCS)

description: NurSusTOOLKIT is a bilingual digital sustainability-literacy and competency resource package for nursing education, including the J3_A1 Children's Health and Environment module, developed for use by nursing educators.
title: NurSusTOOLKIT

description: A global framework developed by the World Health Organization, UNICEF, and the World Bank that guides policies and services providing young children with health, nutrition, safety, responsive caregiving, and early learning opportunities.
title: Nurturing Care Framework
